article_content: Carmen Tarleton, who suffered severe disfigurement after her ex-husband attacked her with industrial lye, has been approved for a rare face transplant. The 43-year-old woman from Vermont, partially blinded and with limited vision, hopes to regain the ability to blink, breathe normally, and eat without difficulty. In 2007, her estranged husband broke into her home, assaulted her with a baseball bat, and poured a strong chemical on her, causing extensive burns. Despite the trauma, Tarleton has become an inspirational figure, sharing her story publicly. Her attacker, Herbert Rodgers, is serving a minimum of 30 years in prison. Tarleton has undergone around 50 surgeries, with 14 focused on her neck. She expressed her struggles with daily activities, emphasizing her desire for normality. The transplant will be performed at Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston, which has successfully conducted three full face transplants this year, including one on Charla Nash, who was attacked by a chimpanzee. Worldwide, at least 18 face transplants have been performed. Tarleton's daughters admire her resilience, with her daughter Hannah expressing pride in her mother's courage. Tarleton underwent extensive testing to qualify for the transplant, including physical evaluations, MRIs, psychiatric assessments, and various therapeutic consultations. The hospital anticipates finding a donor within a few months. The procedure is funded by a $3.4 million grant from the Department of Defense. Tarleton is excited about the transplant, hoping it will alleviate her neck pain and improve her quality of life. She also hopes the transplant will help preserve her vision by allowing her to blink and clear her eye. Tarleton believes she will resemble her former self post-transplant, expressing satisfaction with any outcome that improves her facial functionality.

article_content: Federal investigators are examining whether 55 colleges and universities have illegally handled sexual violence and harassment complaints, the U.S. Department of Education announced Thursday. Although such investigations have been ongoing, this marks the first time the department has publicly released a list of all current probes. The list includes institutions from 27 states and the District of Columbia. View the complete list here. 'We are releasing this list to enhance transparency in our enforcement efforts and to raise public awareness of civil rights issues,' said Catherine E. Lhamon, the department's assistant secretary for civil rights. 'We hope this increased transparency will encourage community dialogue about this important matter. It is important to note that a college or university's inclusion on this list and being subject to a Title IX investigation does not imply any violation of the law at this stage.' Five schools promptly responded to CNN's request for comment. The University of California, Berkeley stated it would cooperate with the investigation and noted that its chancellor had issued a campus-wide letter emphasizing zero tolerance for sexual assault. 'Much has been done to improve our handling of these issues, but we recognize there is always room for improvement,' the university stated. Washington State University reported being notified in January 2013 of a federal complaint and volunteered to collaborate with the Department of Education's Office of Civil Rights to enhance its policies. In February, federal representatives visited Pullman, conducting student focus groups and interviews. 'There has been no finding of wrongdoing by WSU. We are awaiting further communication from OCR regarding the voluntary resolution process,' the university stated, emphasizing zero tolerance for sexual harassment, assault, or misconduct. The University of Wisconsin-Whitewater declined to comment on specifics due to the ongoing investigation but affirmed its serious approach to sexual violence and commitment to supporting victims. The University of Chicago stated it had 'made every effort to comply with the spirit and letter of this inquiry' and is dedicated to ensuring a discrimination-free environment. The University of Colorado Boulder, aware of the probe since July, has hired a law firm for an external policy review and expects to appoint a Title IX director by summer's end. View other responses here. The investigations focus on Title IX, which requires schools to ensure that students are not denied educational opportunities based on sex. The list, reflecting open investigations as of Thursday, provides no case details beyond the investigation's start date. It will be regularly updated and available to the public upon request. In February, CNN featured student and faculty activists from six schools, reporting a near tripling of sexual violence complaints to the Department of Education's Office of Civil Rights since 2009. Thursday's figures follow a significant year-to-year increase in complaints, from 17 in 2012 to 30 in 2013. Five of the six students' universities were included in Thursday's report: the University of Texas-Pan American; Vanderbilt University; the University of California, Berkeley; Occidental College; and Emory University. In the report, Joanna Espinosa, a then-student at UTPA, credited a nationwide network for her decision to come forward. President Barack Obama recently acknowledged the student-led movement as a catalyst for a federal task force to protect students from campus sexual violence. Rape has long been an issue on campuses, but the current movement, driven by activists, survivors, and faculty, frames sexual violence as a cultural problem rather than isolated incidents. Students are taking action, filing complaints, and speaking out, supported by advocacy groups like End Rape on Campus and Know Your IX. Leslie Gomez, a Pennsylvania attorney, former prosecutor, and current sexual assault policy consultant for several colleges, highlighted common concerns across campuses, including lack of clarity, student mistreatment, complex procedures, and insufficient training. After dissatisfaction with her case handling, Espinosa sought help from End Rape on Campus to file a federal complaint. 'I'm not sure I would've come forward if others hadn't done it before me,' Espinosa said. 'I needed the validation. It was a relief to hear someone confirm, 'You have a case, and they shouldn't treat you this way.'' In Thursday's announcement, the Department of Education stated that releasing the list 'advances a key goal of President Obama's White House Task Force to Protect Students from Sexual Assault to bring more transparency to the federal government's enforcement activities around this issue.' The department also issued new guidance outlining schools' responsibilities to address sexual violence and discrimination. All schools must comply with Title IX or risk losing funding and facing Justice Department action. 'Under federal law, sexual violence refers to physical sexual acts perpetrated against a person's will or where a person is incapable of giving consent -- including rape, sexual assault, sexual battery, sexual abuse, and sexual coercion,' the statement concluded.
translated_content: Føderale etterforskere undersøker om 55 universiteter og høyskoler har håndtert seksuelle vold- og trakasseringssaker ulovlig, ifølge USAs utdanningsdepartement som kunngjorde dette torsdag. Selv om slike etterforskninger har pågått, markerer dette første gang departementet offentliggjør en liste over alle pågående undersøkelser. Listen inkluderer institusjoner fra 27 stater og District of Columbia. Se den fullstendige listen her. 'Vi offentliggjør denne listen for å øke gjennomsiktigheten i våre håndhevelsesinnsats og øke offentlig bevissthet om sivile rettigheter', sa Catherine E. Lhamon, departementets assisterende minister for sivile rettigheter. 'Vi håper denne økte gjennomsiktigheten vil oppmuntre til samfunnsdialog om dette viktige temaet. Det er viktig å merke seg at et universitets eller høyskoles inkludering på denne listen og å være gjenstand for en Title IX-undersøkelse ikke impliserer noen lovbrudd på dette stadiet.' Fem skoler svarte raskt på CNNs forespørsel om kommentarer. University of California, Berkeley sa de ville samarbeide med undersøkelsen og nevnte at rektoren hadde sendt ut et brev til hele campus om nulltoleranse for seksuelle overgrep. 'Mye har blitt gjort for å forbedre håndteringen av disse sakene, men vi anerkjenner at det alltid er plass til forbedringer', sa universitetet. Washington State University rapporterte å ha blitt varslet i januar 2013 om en føderal klage og tilbød seg å samarbeide med Utdanningsdepartementets kontor for sivile rettigheter for å forbedre politikken sin. I februar besøkte føderale representanter Pullman og gjennomførte fokusgrupper og intervjuer med studenter og ansatte. 'Det har ikke blitt funnet noen feilgjerninger fra WSU. Vi venter på ytterligere kommunikasjon fra OCR angående deltakelse i den frivillige løsningsprosessen', sa universitetet og understreket nulltoleranse for seksuelle trakasseringer, overgrep eller uønsket oppførsel. University of Wisconsin-Whitewater avstod fra å kommentere spesifikke detaljer grunnet den pågående undersøkelsen, men bekreftet sin alvorlige holdning til seksuell vold og forpliktelse til å støtte ofrene. University of Chicago sa de hadde 'gjort alt for å etterleve ånden og bokstaven i denne forespørselen' og er dedikert til å sikre et diskrimineringsfritt miljø. University of Colorado Boulder, klar over undersøkelsen siden juli, har ansatt et advokatfirma for en ekstern politikkrevurdering og forventer å utnevne en Title IX-direktør innen sommerens slutt. Se andre svar her. Undersøkelsene fokuserer på Title IX, som krever at skolene sikrer at studenter ikke blir nektet muligheter for utdanning basert på kjønn. Listen, som reflekterer åpne undersøkelser per torsdag, gir ingen detaljer om sakene utover når undersøkelsen startet. Den vil bli regelmessig oppdatert og tilgjengelig for offentligheten etter forespørsel. I februar presenterte CNN student- og fakultetsaktivister fra seks skoler, og rapporterte en nesten fordobling av seksuelle volds klager til Utdanningsdepartementets kontor for sivile rettigheter siden 2009. Torsdagens tall følger en betydelig årlig økning i klager, fra 17 i 2012 til 30 i 2013. Fem av de seks studentenes universiteter var inkludert i torsdagens rapport: University of Texas-Pan American; Vanderbilt University; University of California, Berkeley; Occidental College; og Emory University. I rapporten kreditert Joanna Espinosa, en tidligere student ved UTPA, et nasjonalt nettverk for hennes beslutning om å komme frem. President Barack Obama anerkjente nylig studentbevegelsen som en katalysator for en føderal oppgavegruppe for å beskytte studenter mot seksuell vold på campus. Voldtekt har lenge vært et problem på campus, men den nåværende bevegelsen, drevet av aktivister, overlevende og fakultet, rammer inn seksuell vold som et kulturelt problem snarere enn isolerte hendelser. Studenter tar saken i egne hender, sender inn klager og snakker ut, støttet av advocacy grupper som End Rape on Campus og Know Your IX. Leslie Gomez, en advokat fra Pennsylvania, tidligere statsadvokat og nåværende seksuell vold politikk konsulent for flere colleger, pekte på felles bekymringer på tvers av campus, inkludert mangel på klarhet, studenter blir behandlet dårlig, komplekse prosedyre og utilstrekkelig trening. Etter utilfredshet med håndteringen av saken hennes, søkte Espinosa hjelp fra End Rape on Campus for å levere en føderal klage. 'Jeg er ikke sikker på om jeg ville ha kommet frem om ikke andre hadde gjort det før meg', sa Espinosa. 'Jeg trengte valideringen. Det var en lettelse å høre noen si, 'Du har en sak, og de burde ikke behandle deg slik.'' I torsdagens kunngjøring sa Utdanningsdepartementet at å offentliggjøre listen 'fremmer et viktig mål for President Obamas hvite hus oppgavegruppe for å beskytte studenter mot seksuell vold for å bringe mer gjennomsiktighet i den føderale regjeringens håndhevelsesaktiviteter rundt dette temaet.' Departementet utstedte også ny veiledning som beskriver skolenes ansvar for å håndtere seksuell vold og diskriminering. Alle skoler må etterleve Title IX eller risikere å miste finansiering og Justice Department aksjon. 'Etter føderal lov, refererer seksuell vold til fysiske seksuelle handlinger utført mot en persons vilje eller der en person ikke er i stand til å gi samtykke - inkludert voldtekt, seksuelle overgrep, seksuell mishandling, seksuelt misbruk og seksuell tvang', konkluderte uttalelsen.

article_content: By Daily Mail Reporter. PUBLISHED: 11:56 EST, 4 December 2013 | UPDATED: 18:03 EST, 4 December 2013 Danielle Bradbery, the 17-year-old recent winner of 'The Voice,' has been signed as the newest face of Skechers sneakers. The teenage country star's spring 2014 ad campaign for the brand's Bobs line marks her first-ever fashion campaign. She will appear in Skechers's print and TV ads, as well as the brand's social media and marketing campaigns through 2015, reports WWD. The new face: Danielle Bradbery has been named the new face of Skechers, her first-ever fashion campaign. Danielle shot to fame on season 4 of 'The Voice,' at which time she was only 16. After winning the show in June, her first original single 'The Heart of Dixie' reached the top 20 on iTunes. To celebrate her arrival as a Skechers ambassador, the brand's president Michael Greenberg released a statement saying: 'Danielle is a breakout star, and we are thrilled to have Skechers at the starting gate of her incredible career.' He added that 'With a top-20 hit under her belt, she's clearly talented and definitely one to watch. We see the same massive potential in Danielle as we did in Carrie Underwood when we signed her several years ago.' His remarks are a high mark of acclaim for a young star who has previously cited Underwood's career as a musical inspiration. The Bobs brand that she is set to represent for spring 2014 is Skechers's own answer to Toms. Bobs are styled much like Toms's inimitable flat shoes - which were modeled after a traditional Argentinian shoe called alpargatas. Also like Toms, Skechers donates a pair of shoes to a child in need for each pair of Bobs that are purchased. Of the line, Danielle said in a statement: 'Bobs shoes have helped so many children in need with their donation program, and I love the fact that it really is a simple way for anyone to give back.' Her idol: Danielle has previously cited Carrie Underwood as her musical inspiration, and now follows in the singer's footsteps as the face of Skechers.

article_content: The World Series between the Texas Rangers and Arizona Diamondbacks was the least-viewed in television history. (AP Photo/Brynn Anderson) With the Texas Rangers winning the World Series, Major League Baseball officially wrapped up their 2023 season. From a viewership perspective, it created a host of narratives. But, should any of it affect the league’s national or regional media rights deals? Fans of the Rangers will undoubtedly be excited today given that they had never won a World Series. The club had spent more than any of the other 29 teams in MLB over the last two years, so in many ways it should have been no surprise. But baseball is baseball. By that, I mean it is the most team-centric of all the major sports. Where basketball or football can see one player greatly influence a game's outcome, baseball requires focusing on the entire roster. To emphasize that, Game 5 of the World Series was a microcosm of this fact. Arizona’s Zac Gallen did not allow a hit through six innings and had retired 14 batters before ever issuing a walk. And yet, the Diamondbacks' bats were lifeless, going 0 for 9 with runners in scoring position. With that in mind, baseball is brand-driven. Other sports are star-driven. And given that the Rangers and Diamondbacks were in the Fall Classic, it set itself up for low viewership. With the final numbers in, the 2023 World Series was the least-viewed since Nielsen began tracking. Averaging 9.1 million viewers, it sank below the 2020 'bubble' series during the pandemic between the Dodgers and Rays (which averaged 9.9 million). FOX made lemonade out of lemons with Game 5, which averaged 11.6 million viewers across all their platforms and won the night. Sports and the teams that make the championships are cyclical. Parity is important. Whether 2023 is a bust for national viewership gets into whether you want a handful of big brands in the World Series and the other teams are simply there as fodder for the regular season. Not every year can be a Yankees, or Red Sox, or Dodgers, or Cubs championship, and as a fan you say thank goodness for that. But the media landscape, which has seen subscribers flee traditional television for streaming services, adds a bit to the MLB postseason malaise in viewership. As noted, it’s one year but comes at a time when ESPN and MLB have a mutual opt-out at the end of the 2025 season for their national broadcast deal, which includes the Wild Card series. Overall, ESPN’s Sunday Night Baseball was down -2% on the season, but speaking with Phil Orlins, Vice President, Production for MLB, he said that was largely due to having a slate with the Yankees, Red Sox, and Mets in a down year for both. He said those clubs accounted for 25 of 30 broadcast windows and therefore, he was bullish on the season. 'To be basically flat under those circumstances is, I think, a really good sign about the overall health and interest in [Major League Baseball].' On the regional sports network side, it was impossible to not have the Diamond Sports Group bankruptcy hang over the league. MLB took over the rights to the Padres and Diamondbacks mid-season from Diamond Sports Group, and with them controlling the majority of MLB regional sports networks, it should not be surprising if the league took over the majority of them as either Diamond Sports Group foregoes making rights payments, or contracts expire, opening the door for MLB to produce and work carriage deals for them. In aggregate, the RSNs were up +7% during the 2023 regular season (see numbers for all 29 U.S. teams here), with most of them ranking #1 in primetime. That’s important given other non-sports content in the DVR era has seen a dramatic drop in viewership over the last few years. There will be a lot of discussion about MLB’s playoff format that saw marquee brands that handily won their divisions get knocked off in the early rounds by wild card teams. That is the randomness of a sport that sees 3-game, 5-game, and 7-game series play for their postseason. But using 2023 as a measuring stick doesn’t mean subsequent years will follow suit. And that randomness lends itself to the parity component. Since the 1998-2000 New York Yankees, MLB has not seen a repeat World Series winner.
translated_content: World Series mellom Texas Rangers og Arizona Diamondbacks var den minst sette i fjernsynshistorien. (AP Photo/Brynn Anderson) Med Texas Rangers som vant World Series, avsluttet Major League Baseball offisielt 2023-sesongen. Fra et seertallsperspektiv skapte det en rekke fortellinger. Men, burde noe av det påvirke ligaens nasjonale eller regionale medierettighetsavtaler? Fans av Rangers vil utvilsomt være glade i dag siden de aldri har vunnet en World Series. Klubben hadde brukt mer enn noen av de andre 29 lagene i MLB de siste to årene, så på mange måter burde det ikke ha vært noen overraskelse. Men baseball er baseball. Med det mener jeg at det er den mest lagbaserte av alle de store sportene. Der basketball eller fotball kan se en spiller påvirke resultatet av en kamp, krever baseball fokus på hele troppen. For å understreke det, var kamp 5 av World Series et mikrokosmos av denne fakta. Arizonas Zac Gallen tillot ikke en hit gjennom seks innings og hadde pensjonert 14 slagmenn før han noensinne utstedte en walk. Og likevel var Diamondbacks' staver uten liv, og gikk 0 for 9 med løpere i scoringsposisjon. Med det i tankene er baseball merkevarebygd. Andre idretter er stjernebygde. Og med tanke på at Rangers og Diamondbacks var i Fall Classic, satte det seg selv opp for lavt seertall. Med de endelige tallene var 2023 World Series det minst sette siden Nielsen begynte å spore. I gjennomsnitt 9,1 millioner seere, sank det under 2020 'boble'-serien under pandemien mellom Dodgers og Rays (som i gjennomsnitt hadde 9,9 millioner). FOX laget sitronlim av sitroner med kamp 5, som i gjennomsnitt hadde 11,6 millioner seere på tvers av alle plattformene og vant kvelden. Sport og lagene som lager mesterskapene er sykliske. Likhet er viktig. Uansett om 2023 er en fiasko for nasjonalt seertall, handler det om om du vil ha et håndfull store merker i World Series og de andre lagene bare er der som fôr for seriespillet. Ikke hvert år kan være en Yankees, eller Red Sox, eller Dodgers, eller Cubs-mesterskap, og som en fan sier du takk gud for det. Men medielandskapet, som har sett abonnenter flykte fra tradisjonell fjernsyn til strømmingstjenester, legger til litt i MLB-slutspillets apati i seertall. Som nevnt, det er ett år, men det kommer på et tidspunkt da ESPN og MLB har en gjensidig utmeldning ved slutten av 2025-sesongen for sin nasjonale kringkastingsavtale, som inkluderer Wild Card-serien. Samlet sett var ESPNs Sunday Night Baseball ned -2% for sesongen, men å snakke med Phil Orlins, visepresident, produksjon for MLB, sa han at det i stor grad skyldtes å ha en rekke med Yankees, Red Sox og Mets i et nedgangsår for begge. Han sa at disse klubbene sto for 25 av 30 kringkastingsvinduer og derfor var han optimistisk med sesongen. 'Å være grunnleggende flatt under disse omstendighetene er, tror jeg, et veldig godt tegn på den generelle helsen og interessen for [Major League Baseball].' På den regionale sportskanal-siden var det umulig å ikke la Diamond Sports Group-konkursen henge over ligaen. MLB overtok rettighetene til Padres og Diamondbacks midt i sesongen fra Diamond Sports Group, og med dem kontrollerer de flertallet av MLB regionale sportskanaler, så det bør ikke overraske hvis ligaen overtar flertallet av dem enten Diamond Sports Group unnlater å betale rettighetsbetalinger, eller kontrakter utløper, åpner døren for MLB å produsere og arbeide med transportavtaler for dem. Totalt sett var RSN opp +7% under 2023-sesongen (se tall for alle 29 amerikanske lag her), med de fleste av dem rangert som #1 i beste sendetid. Det er viktig med tanke på at annen ikke-sportinnhold i DVR-æraen har sett en dramatisk nedgang i seertall de siste årene. Det vil bli mye diskusjon om MLBs sluttspillsformat som så store merkevarer som lett vant divisjonene sine ble slått ut i de tidlige rundene av wild card-lag. Det er tilfeldigheten i en sport som ser 3-kamp, 5-kamp og 7-kamp-serier spille for sluttspillet. Men å bruke 2023 som en målestokk betyr ikke at påfølgende år vil følge etter. Og den tilfeldigheten bidrar til likhetskomponenten. Siden 1998-2000 New York Yankees har ikke MLB sett en gjentatt World Series-vinner.

article_content: A Russian mother of two, Emma Gomolko from St. Petersburg, has become an internet sensation after her thrilling motorbike stunt videos went viral on social media. Her daring performances on busy roads have captivated both everyday Russians and motorbike enthusiasts, earning her the affectionate nickname 'Emma the Motor Racer'. The footage showcases her executing risky and complex stunts amidst traffic, including standing on the bike while it's moving and performing maneuvers with her hands off the handlebars. article_content: By Daily Mail Reporter. PUBLISHED: 16:45 EST, 22 January 2013. UPDATED: 03:15 EST, 23 January 2013. A personal assistant who claimed her boss wanted to 'trade her in for a younger model' has won an unfair dismissal case at a tribunal. Dawn Bailey, 52, stated that she felt compelled to leave her £75,000 a year job at defence giant Lockheed Martin last February. This decision came after she developed the chronic illness sarcoidosis and depression around the time she turned 50. Bailey was the PA to chief executive Stephen Ball. She told the tribunal that he repeatedly mocked her age and described her illness as 'disruptive'. Although the tribunal found that Ball's comments about a 'younger model' were made in jest, they ruled that Bailey had been wrongfully dismissed and subjected to unfavourable treatment due to her depression. The Central London Employment Tribunal concluded that the multi-billion pound company should have provided more support to Bailey after she was diagnosed with depression and anxiety in November 2011. The tribunal noted that Bailey had an 'unblemished' career at Lockheed Martin, but her relationship with Ball soured after her sarcoidosis diagnosis. Over the following year, Bailey took several weeks off work due to illness. The tribunal found that her job was marginalized and sidelined during her absences. Bailey also testified that Ball repeatedly told her, 'I need to trade you in for a younger model' and 'It is time for a younger, new team'. In December 2011, Bailey was suspended on 'management directed leave' pending a health evaluation. Three months later, she resigned, stating that all confidence and trust had been destroyed by the company. The tribunal found that Bailey was marginalized upon her return to work and did not receive proactive support from HR. Bailey’s solicitor, Paul McAleavey, highlighted the discrimination faced by many middle-aged women in UK workplaces. He expressed satisfaction with the ruling but criticized the tribunal's dismissal of Ball's comments as humorous. A remedy hearing will be held next month to determine Bailey's compensation.

article_content: David Silva is determined to win the Champions League and establish Manchester City as one of the world's top teams after signing a new five-year deal at the Etihad. Silva is the third player to recently extend his contract, following Samir Nasri and Aleksandar Kolarov, with Sergio Aguero and Vincent Kompany expected to follow suit. Since joining City from Valencia for £24m four years ago, Silva has won two Premier League titles, the FA Cup, and the Capital One Cup. Now, the talented Spanish midfielder aims to conquer Europe. Asked about his goals before his contract expires in 2019, Silva stated, ‘Definitely the Champions League. It’s a title I really want to win. I believe we are on the right path and hope to win it someday. It’s a significant challenge for this year. We also aim to win other titles and compete for every trophy.’ Silva, reportedly earning £200,000 a week, did not hesitate to extend his stay. ‘It was an easy decision to stay at Manchester City, a club with amazing fans who have always supported me,’ he added. ‘From the moment I joined four years ago, it has felt like a second home. Both on and off the pitch, I feel incredibly content and professionally fulfilled, so why wouldn’t I want to stay and keep winning trophies with this fantastic team?’ ‘Over the past four years, we have achieved so much together, making City a dominant force in England. Now, looking around this dressing room, I see no reason why we won’t become one of the world's top teams.’ In addition to renewing key players' contracts, City has spent nearly £50m this summer on Eliaquim Mangala, Willy Caballero, Fernando, and Bruno Zuculini. Bacary Sagna joined from Arsenal as a free agent, and Frank Lampard is on a six-month loan from New York City FC. ‘They are all great players,’ said Silva. ‘The club is doing well by signing top talent, which will benefit the team and increase competition. Higher competition raises the team's level. Lampard brings a lot of experience and will contribute significantly to the team.’

Det er en tittel jeg virkelig ønsker å vinne. Jeg tror vi er på rett vei og håper å vinne den en dag. Det er en stor utfordring for i år. Vi ønsker også å vinne andre titler og konkurrere om alle troféer.’ Silva, som skal tjene £200,000 i uken, tøyde ikke med å forlenge oppholdet sitt. ‘Det var en lett beslutning å bli i Manchester City, en klubb med fantastiske fans som alltid har støttet meg,’ la han til. ‘Fra det første øyeblikket jeg kom for fire år siden, har det føltes som et annet hjem. Nå, når jeg ser meg omkring i garderoben, ser jeg ingen grunn til at vi ikke skal bli et av verdens beste lag.’ I tillegg til å fornye kontrakter med nøkkelspillere, har City brukt nesten £50m denne sommeren på Eliaquim Mangala, Willy Caballero, Fernando og Bruno Zuculini. article_content: By Mike Dawes. James Anderson will face a preliminary hearing next Tuesday on his Level 3 disciplinary charge, following the altercation between him and India all-rounder Ravindra Jadeja. The International Cricket Council has announced that the first stage in the procedure - involving Jadeja too, at Level 2 under the governing body's code of conduct - will be a teleconference with appointed judicial commissioner Gordon Lewis. The preliminary hearing is to take place, as stipulated in ICC protocol, as soon as practicably possible - on the day after the ongoing second Investec Test is scheduled to finish at Lord's. Alleged altercation: James Anderson and Ravindra Jadeja exchanged words at Trent Bridge. Heated: James Anderson and Ravindra Jadeja exchange words during the first Test at Trent Bridge. On song: England's strike bowler seemed unfazed by the allegations as he took four wickets on Thursday. Appeal: If Anderson is found guilty, he could be banned for up to four matches before any appeal. The primary task for Lewis, Australia's representative on the ICC's code of conduct commission, will be to 'address preliminary issues' in the case before setting a date for a full hearing. Anderson and Jadeja have been charged after their fracas in the stairwell of the Trent Bridge pavilion as they made their way off for lunch on day two of the drawn first Test. It is highly unlikely that there will be any decisive outcome at the preliminary hearing - although an amendment to the level of charge is possible for either player. Verbals: Anderson and Jadeja have a frank exchange of views out in the middle on day two. Tension: James Anderson waits to talk to Ravindra Jadeja and MS Dhoni as they walk off for lunch. Jubilant Jimmy: Anderson (center) celebrates dismissing Ravindra Jadeja during the first Test. For Anderson, for example, a reduction from Level 3 to 2 - for allegedly 'abusing and pushing' Jadeja - would drastically reduce the probability of any resulting suspension during the remainder of the five-match series against India.
